Team — following up from today's discovery call with Summit Health (Tom & Anya). Sending an exec-friendly recap so we can align on asks, risk, procurement path, and what I recommend we prioritize for the pilot.

- Primary: Reduce clinician admin time by ~30% within 12 months (focus: visit notes, inbox triage).
- Secondary: Improve patient message response SLAs and reduce unnecessary escalations to clinicians.
- Success metrics: avg clinician minutes/day on admin, percent of messages auto-answered, reduction in time-to-first-response.

2) Pain points / constraints
- Current attachment: heavy manual summarization and template-driven replies; existing vendor attempts failed on hallucinations and PHI redaction.
- Compliance: must pass their security review (SOC 2 evidence, encryption at rest/in transit, audit logs).
- Procurement: procurement cycle is 6–8 weeks post-security signoff; legal requests standard BAA and data processing terms.

3) Risk / escalation items
- If SOC 2 evidence isn't available quickly, security will delay pilot approvals — priority #1.
- Exec sponsorship: Anya is clinically aligned but needs a short (15–20 min) exec briefing to get signoff for pilot scope.
- Cost sensitivity: they'll expect a clear pilot pricing model and a path to committed capacity if pilot meets targets.

- Schedule exec brief: 15–20 min with Anya + Tom + Laura (our leadership) for next week — owner: marissa_cole / laura_bennett — ETA: propose 2026-03-24

5) Proposed pilot scope (high level)
- 6-week pilot covering visit note generation and inbox triage for one clinic cohort (~10 clinicians).
- Metrics collection for quality/regression tied to their gold-standard prompts and evals.
